heading: Thursday, March 20, 2025
topLine: OpenAI launches next-generation audio models in the API.

items.headline: OpenAI launches next-generation audio models in the API
items.summary: OpenAI added gpt-4o-transcribe and gpt-4o-mini-transcribe speech-to-text models, which it says lower word error rates versus Whisper, plus gpt-4o-mini-tts, a text-to-speech model whose tone and style can be steered by instructions.
